summary: HCA Healthcare filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026, reporting first-quarter 2026 results. Revenues rose 4.3% to $19.109B, net income increased 0.6% to $1.620B, and diluted EPS grew 10.9% to $7.15. The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.78 per share, payable June 30, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or issuer tender is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
